_: How the book is recorded. tools/narrate.mjs reads this; .github/workflows/narrate.yml runs it every night and whenever this file changes on main. Leave a voice empty until it has been picked on /book/voices.html. Changing a voice, the style or the model records that edition again; raising samples.round records new samples. 'accent' is added only for voices that are not already Indian; 'hint' is always added.

en.style: Narrate this like an audiobook: warm, calm and clear, at an unhurried pace, with a natural pause between paragraphs.
en.accent: Speak with a natural Indian English accent, like an educated speaker from Delhi or Mumbai.

hi.style: Narrate this like an audiobook in natural spoken Hinglish, the way people in North India talk at work. Warm, calm and clear, at an unhurried pace.
hi.accent: Speak with a natural Indian accent.
hi.hint: The text is Hindi written in English letters, mixed with English words: read the Hindi words as Hindi, and the English terms in Indian English.
